title: 咘咘的毕业典礼和第一次看海
title_en: Bubu's Graduation Show and First Trip to the Sea

pages.text: 咘咘的毕业典礼和第一次看海
pages.text_en: Bubu's Graduation Show and First Trip to the Sea

pages.text: 今天幼儿园有毕业典礼！虽然咘咘不是毕业班的，但她也要上台表演节目呢！早上起来，咘咘就兴奋得蹦蹦跳跳。
pages.text_en: Today the kindergarten is having a graduation ceremony! Even though Bubu isn't in the graduating class, she gets to perform on stage too! She was so excited she bounced around all morning.

pages.text: 爸爸、妈妈、爷爷、奶奶全家出动，一起来看咘咘表演！爸爸举着手机准备录像，妈妈牵着咘咘的手，爷爷和奶奶笑呵呵地跟在后面。
pages.text_en: Dad, Mom, Grandpa, and Grandma all came together to watch Bubu perform! Dad held up his phone to record, Mom held Bubu's hand, and Grandpa and Grandma followed behind with big smiles.

pages.text: 幼儿园装饰得好漂亮！五颜六色的气球挂在门口，彩带飘在空中，舞台上挂着一块大横幅，写着「毕业快乐」。
pages.text_en: The kindergarten was beautifully decorated! Colorful balloons hung at the entrance, streamers floated in the air, and a big banner on stage read 'Happy Graduation'.

pages.text: 毕业班的大哥哥大姐姐们穿着整齐的小礼服，站在舞台上唱歌。有的小朋友眼眶红红的，因为要离开幼儿园了。李老师在旁边也偷偷擦了擦眼睛。
pages.text_en: The graduating kids stood on stage in neat little suits and dresses, singing together. Some had teary eyes because they were leaving kindergarten. Teacher Li quietly wiped her eyes too.

pages.text: 终于轮到咘咘的节目了！粤语《水果歌》！小朋友们在后台排好队，每个人都穿着不同的水果服装。
pages.text_en: Finally it was time for Bubu's act! The Cantonese 'Fruit Song'! The little ones lined up backstage, each wearing a different fruit costume.

pages.text: 有扮草莓的小猫同学，扮香蕉的小狗同学，扮葡萄的小熊同学……咘咘扮的是——大苹果！红红圆圆的苹果服装，可爱极了！
pages.text_en: Feifei the kitten was a strawberry, Moyu the corgi was a banana, the little bear was grapes... and Bubu was — a big apple! Her round red apple costume was adorable!

pages.text: 音乐响起来了！咘咘穿着红红的苹果服装，在舞台中央唱歌跳舞。她的小脚丫踩着节拍，小手拍着节奏，白白的兔耳朵从苹果帽子里伸出来，一晃一晃的。
pages.text_en: The music started! Bubu danced and sang center stage in her red apple costume. Her little feet tapped to the beat, her paws clapped the rhythm, and her white bunny ears poked out from the apple hat, bobbing along.

pages.text: 台下，爸爸举着手机录像，激动得手都在抖。妈妈眼眶湿湿的，使劲鼓掌。爷爷竖起大拇指，奶奶笑得合不拢嘴。NOMI和NONO也在人群里拍手叫好。
pages.text_en: In the audience, Dad's hands shook with excitement as he recorded. Mom's eyes glistened as she clapped hard. Grandpa gave a thumbs up, and Grandma beamed with joy. NOMI and NONO cheered and clapped along in the crowd.

pages.text: 表演结束了！李老师蹲下来，轻轻摸摸咘咘的头说：「咘咘太棒了！唱得真好听！」咘咘抱着李老师的大胖胳膊，开心地笑了。
pages.text_en: The show was over! Teacher Li knelt down, gently patted Bubu's head and said: 'Bubu, you were amazing! You sang so beautifully!' Bubu hugged Teacher Li's big soft arm and smiled happily.

pages.text: 毕业典礼结束后，爸爸神秘地说：「今天有一个惊喜！带咘咘去看——大海！」咘咘瞪大了眼睛：「大海？大海是什么呀？」
pages.text_en: After the ceremony, Dad said mysteriously: 'There's a surprise today! We're taking Bubu to see — the ocean!' Bubu's eyes went wide: 'The ocean? What's the ocean?'

pages.text: 全家开车来到深圳的海边。远远地，咘咘就闻到了一股咸咸的味道。车门打开的那一刻——哇！蓝蓝的大海一望无际！
pages.text_en: The whole family drove to the seaside in Shenzhen. From far away, Bubu could smell something salty. The moment the car door opened — WOW! The vast blue ocean stretched endlessly before her!

pages.text: 咘咘第一次看到大海！她的眼睛瞪得圆圆的，嘴巴张成了一个大大的O。海浪一层一层地涌过来，发出哗——哗——的声音。
pages.text_en: It was Bubu's first time seeing the ocean! Her eyes went perfectly round and her mouth formed a big 'O'. Waves rolled in one after another, making a gentle 'whoosh — whoosh' sound.

pages.text: 咘咘脱掉小凉鞋，光着脚踩在沙滩上。「好软好软！」沙子暖暖的，从脚趾缝里钻出来，痒痒的。咘咘咯咯地笑了。
pages.text_en: Bubu took off her little sandals and stepped barefoot onto the sand. 'So soft!' The warm sand squeezed between her toes, tickling her. Bubu giggled and giggled.

pages.text: 爸爸牵着咘咘的手走到海边，小浪花扑过来打在咘咘的脚上。「啊！好凉！」咘咘又兴奋又有点害怕，紧紧拉着爸爸的手，但又忍不住往前走。妈妈在后面笑着拍照。
pages.text_en: Dad held Bubu's hand as they walked to the water's edge. A little wave splashed over her feet. 'Ah! It's cold!' Bubu was excited and a little scared, gripping Dad's hand tight but couldn't help stepping forward. Mom laughed and took photos from behind.

pages.text: 咘咘和大家在沙滩上玩了好久。她捡了好多漂亮的贝壳，和爷爷一起堆沙堡，还追着海鸥跑。NOMI用灵巧的小手帮咘咘在沙堡上插了一面小旗子，NONO站在沙堡尖顶上当「守卫」。
pages.text_en: Bubu played on the beach for a long time. She collected pretty seashells, built a sandcastle with Grandpa, and chased seagulls. NOMI used her clever little paws to plant a tiny flag on the sandcastle, while NONO perched on top as the 'guard'.

pages.text: 夕阳把天空染成了橘红色，海面金光闪闪。全家人站在海边拍了一张大合影——爸爸、妈妈、爷爷、奶奶、咘咘、NOMI和NONO，每个人脸上都是满满的笑容。
pages.text_en: The sunset painted the sky orange and red, the sea shimmering with golden light. The whole family took a big group photo by the shore — Dad, Mom, Grandpa, Grandma, Bubu, NOMI and NONO, every face glowing with happiness.

pages.text: 回家的路上，咘咘在车里睡着了。小手里还紧紧握着一个粉色的小贝壳，嘴角带着甜甜的微笑。今天是最棒的一天——在舞台上唱了歌，还第一次看到了大海。咘咘的梦里，一定也有蓝蓝的海浪和金色的沙滩吧。
pages.text_en: On the way home, Bubu fell asleep in the car. Her little paw still held a pink seashell tightly, a sweet smile on her lips. Today was the best day ever — she sang on stage and saw the ocean for the first time. In her dreams, there must be blue waves and golden sand too.
